steps.hardClue: Assemble the four parts beside the courthouse.
steps.clue: Build the gallows beside the courthouse.

steps.hardClue: Destroy all four red orbs using a powered buildable device.
steps.clue: Shatter all four red orbs with a Turbine-powered Subsurface Resonator.

steps.hardClue: Knock down the floating lantern with a grenade.
steps.clue: Knock down the floating lantern with a grenade.

steps.hardClue: Charge the lantern, then place it on the rooftop symbol.
steps.clue: Charge the lantern with zombies killed by Arthur, then place it on the rooftop symbol.

steps.hardClue: Decode the message and strike the three correct signs in the tunnels.
steps.clue: Decode the lantern message and strike the three named tunnel signs.

steps.hardClue: Guide the wisp to the gallows, travel back in time, then guide it there again.
steps.clue: Guide the wisp to the gallows, trigger the Time Bomb, then guide it there again.

steps.hardClue: Ring the nine bells as directed by the switchboard.
steps.clue: Ring the nine bells as directed by the mansion switchboard.

steps.hardClue: Make a wish, then shoot all the targets that appear.
steps.clue: Make a wish at the fountain, then complete the Sharpshooter challenge.
